intro: Georgia runs its elections county by county, through each county's board of elections and registration, with the Secretary of State overseeing the state.

id_rule.text: Bring a valid government-issued photo ID to the polls.

check.text: Check your Georgia voter registration and polling place on My Voter Page.
check.label: Am I registered?

elections.name: General election
elections.what: Federal, state and local offices, plus any statewide or local measures. Your exact ballot depends on where you live.

dates.label: Last day to register to vote
dates.detail: This is the voter registration deadline for the Nov. 3 general election.

dates.label: Early voting
dates.detail: Vote at any early voting site in your county of residence. Hours are generally Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm, and counties may open as early as 7 am and close as late as 7 pm.

dates.label: Absentee ballot application must be received
dates.detail: Your county election office must have your application by this date.

dates.label: Election Day
dates.detail: Polls are open 7 am to 7 pm, and you can vote if you are in line by 7 pm. A mail ballot must be received by your county registrar by 7 pm.
